newsitem.title: USA: NYPA 780 MW Fitzpatrick plant in restart mode.
newsitem.headline: NYPA 780 MW Fitzpatrick plant in restart mode.

text.p: New York Power Authority's (NYPA) 780 megawatt James A. Fitzpatrick nuclear power plant in Scriba, N.Y. began startup early Monday after a maintenance outage, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said.
The unit was in startup but was operating at less than one percent of power as of early Monday, the NRC said in its daily plant status report.
Fitzpatrick was shut Oct 26 for scheduled maintenance and refueling.
Nuclear power units typically go through several days of testing during restart before reaching full power.
